title: Industrial cities and their legacy
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:18Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The closest bank point, Cities and public health, covers only crowded housing and disease, while the new point also covers Britain's industrial power, smoke pollution and the spread of industrial change around the world, so it is a narrower match and a new point is needed.

draft.title: Industrial cities and their legacy
card: Industry made Britain wealthy and powerful. It made goods in large amounts and sold them around the world.
Towns such as Manchester and Birmingham grew very fast as people moved there for work. Housing was built quickly and was often crowded.
Coal smoke filled the air and waste went into rivers. Many homes had poor water and drains, so disease spread easily.
Industrial methods spread to other countries, such as the United States and Germany, and changed how people lived and worked far beyond Britain.
draft.remember: Industry made Britain powerful, its cities grew fast, crowded and polluted, and industrial change spread worldwide.

a.q: Why did diseases spread easily in many early industrial cities?
opts: Crowded homes had poor water and drains
Workers moved back to villages in large numbers
Factories stopped using coal for power
Cities grew slowly, so housing was plentiful
a.why: Fast growth meant crowded housing with poor water and drains, so disease spread easily. Cities did not grow slowly: they grew fast, and coal use was high, not low.
a.clue: Think about how people lived once they crowded into new towns.

b.q: A visitor to Manchester in the 1840s sees smoky skies, crowded streets and new factories. What best explains this scene?
opts: Industry drew many workers to a fast-growing city
Farmers had left the city to work on the land
Reformers had cleaned the air and built new homes
Britain had stopped selling goods overseas
b.why: Industry drew people to cities for work, so they grew fast, crowded and polluted. The scene does not suggest that people left for farms or that conditions had been cleaned up.
b.clue: Where did people move to find work?

a.best: Crowded homes had poor water and drains

b.best: Industry drew many workers to a fast-growing city
